item: A source stored under a bare Wikidata id is shown under its domain; the field bundle splits the flat source count (row 71)
refs: PR pending; field test 2026-11-14 report 5.4 7.3 rec 14
summary: The field test saw epari.fi credited as 'Q11858063' in the reader: 315 shipped catalogue rows and many discovery candidates are stored under a bare Wikidata id because their label was never resolved. The reader page and its JSON already do so on main (576e062ef); every other display path that credits an article to its source (feed, Explore instant search, latest, links, insights intensity, framing, markets, the LLM prompt's source line) now shows the domain instead, through one dependency-free helper whose pattern a test pins to the label resolver's. The STORED name is unchanged, so the consented resolve-qid-names endpoint and the raw-ids count still find the row, and the CSV/JSON exports keep the stored value as provenance. The Sources tab keeps the stored name beside the domain. The in-app headline already counts only collecting sources (Q1114); the field-data bundle's flat 'sources' (20k-37k on the field test) now carries the same partition (collecting, enabled not qualified, not enabled) plus how many are named by a bare id, and a sources_never_stored breakdown (enabled, status, feed, last attempt verdict, last fetch status; at most 200 groups) for the about 25k sources that never stored an article (row 39).
